The Linux driver for the device specifies the USB ID as 0b05:17ad. [http://www.driverhive.com/driverdetails.aspx?m=ASUSTeK+Computer+Inc.&d=ASUS+USB-N66+450Mbps+Dual+Band+USB+Adapter Other sources] seem to indicate the device ID is 0b05:17bc. :[http://forums.linuxmint.com/viewtopic.php?f=53&t=113764&p=635314 The USB ID appears to be 0b05:17ad].
"USB-N66 REV 1.10" and "PCB MADE IN CHINA" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos.
